name: strandbeest
title: strandbeest
blurb: a theo jansen walking machine that actually walks: a rigid body on contact springs, planted feet gripping the sand and dragging it forward, legs that fall and land under gravity. endless procedural dunes swell into mountains, through the clouds, and back to the sea. suspension, rigid chassis, gravity, tilt, ride height, leg spacing and crank phasing are all separate controls. asked for by blindguymcsleazy.bsky.social.
